body:
> Does it leak? as far as I can tell no. One of the of props of InstantSearch let you pass your own implementation, while theoretically nice to have, I don't know why we would and I suggest we remove it if we're not sure :)

Currently I thought it leaked since the history prop expects an history object that must comply with history (V2!) API.

What we need to ensure is that we can use react-instantsearch in an environnement where react-router is already used and react-instantsearch comes on top.
